about: Verified local download routes for open-weights catalogue models that had no local variant. Each variant follows lib/types.ts Variant; sizes come from the Hugging Face API file listing or the ollama registry manifest at the cited revision.

variants.cmd: hf download deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --local-dir DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-HF && cd DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-HF/inference && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python convert.py --hf-ckpt-path .. --save-path ../../DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-TP8 --model-parallel 8 --expert-dtype fp4 --tokenizer-path .. && torchrun --nproc-per-node 8 generate.py --ckpt-path ../../DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-TP8 --config config.json --interactive --temperature 0.6
variants.note: DeepSeek's own reference runtime from the repo's inference/ folder, which the model card's 'Minimal Inference' section points to ('instructions on weight conversion and running inference locally'): pip install -r requirements.txt (torch>=2.10.0, tilelang==0.1.8, ...), convert.py to one checkpoint per tensor-parallel rank (MP=8, --expert-dtype fp4, as in the README), then the README's interactive torchrun generate.py command. The README calls it 'A readable reference implementation rather than a production serving engine'; it needs 8 GPUs for MP=8 and the self-test exercises 'the real dense-fp8 / MoE-fp4 kernels'. No GGUF from the accepted publishers and no vLLM architecture entry (DeepseekV41ForCausalLM) exist yet. gb is the size of the 48 model-*.safetensors files in deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash@2cba9e4 (Hugging Face API file listing, fetched 2026-10-07); config quantization_config: quant_method fp8, expert_dtype fp4 (safetensors metadata: F8_E4M3 204,015,223,296 and I8 557,171,343,360 parameters). convert.py writes a second, converted copy of similar size.
